fi|ee85fbcda8f06056.en: Legislative proposals: Act amending the Protocol amending the Agreement and the Protocol on double taxation of income and wealth taxes with Switzerland; Protocol amending the Agreement and Protocol between the Republic of Finland and the Swiss Confederation on double taxation of income and wealth taxes in Helsinki on 16 December 1991, as amended by the Protocols of 19 April 2006, 22 September 2009 and 18 September 2012, as amended by the Helsinki Protocol of 19 April 2006, 22 September 2009 and 18 September 2012
